'''Brother Brace''' is a [[Saradomin]]ist [[monk]] on [[Tutorial Island]] who teaches players how to use [[Prayer]]. Players can find him in the chapel on Tutorial Island.

==Trivia==
*He seems to wear a golden [[holy symbol]].
*Brother Brace is named after Simon Brace, a former [[Jagex Moderator]] also known to players as "modsimon".{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1448349242154799105|date=13 October 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96683|archivedate=27 June 2023|quote=(...) For what it's worth, Brother Brace was named after a former member of staff, if you're collecting trivia about those NPCs' names.}}
